shouldFix.title: The Claude v6 inventory records no advisories where the frozen bytes carry two, and neither advisory is booked anywhere
shouldFix.what: I parsed the frozen Claude v6 verdict at b197e486, mode 0444, the digest this ledger itself pins. Its true finding set is 0 blockers, 3 SHOULD-FIX and 2 advisories: CLAUDE-V6-ADV-1 and CLAUDE-V6-ADV-2. The claude2v6 entry carries verdict, blockers and shouldFix but has no advisories key at all. idCollisionNote says only 'Claude v6 used CLAUDE-V6-S1..S3.' I searched the whole artifact: the strings CLAUDE-V6-ADV-1 and CLAUDE-V6-ADV-2 occur zero times.
shouldFix.whyThisIsTheThirdRecurrence: This is the same defect at the same position for the third consecutive generation. v4 recorded Codex v3 as carrying one finding when its bytes carried two - CLAUDE-V4-S1, repaired at v5. v6 recorded Codex v5 as carrying zero advisories against two - CLAUDE-V6-S3 and CODEX-V6-S2, repaired here at v7. v7 now records Claude v6 as carrying zero advisories against two. Each generation repairs the instance it was told about and reproduces the class against the verdict it just repaired from.
shouldFix.whatIsActuallyLost: Both advisories are live and undischarged, and this is why I did not file it as an advisory itself. CLAUDE-V6-ADV-1 concerns reMeasurementAtV5 being named for the v5 epoch while holding a v6-epoch measurement; v7 leaves that block untouched, so the condition persists exactly as described. CLAUDE-V6-ADV-2 concerns reviewGuidance accretion; v7 leaves the list at 26 entries, so that persists too. Neither was fixed, and neither was declined - they are simply absent.
shouldFix.theAggravatingDetail: The artifact demonstrates in the same object that it knows how to handle an undischarged advisory. notFoldedThisSuccessor books CODEX-V5-A1 and CODEX-V5-A2 individually and CLAUDE-V5-ADV-1..4 as a group, all explicitly not folded. The machinery for booking exactly this case is present, populated and working - the Claude v6 advisories are the only undischarged findings in the lineage that get neither an inventory line nor a not-folded line.
shouldFix.whyNotABlocker: No contract claim is touched and nothing is fail-open. The advisories are recoverable one hop away from the pinned reviewer file, which the ledger still cites at the correct digest, and both are low-severity clarity items rather than custody defects. This is the same not-a-blocker reasoning applied to the two prior instances of the class.
shouldFix.minimumRepair: Add advisories [CLAUDE-V6-ADV-1, CLAUDE-V6-ADV-2] to the claude2v6 entry, name them in idCollisionNote, and give each an explicit disposition - fold it with a honestyRepairsFromV7 line, or book it in notFoldedThisSuccessor as was done for the Codex v5 pair. Preserve v7 bytes and name the changed paths in the successor roster.
shouldFix.structuralSuggestionNotRequired: Three recurrences at the same position suggest the per-generation fix is not holding. A standing rule in basedOn.method - that every ledger entry carries blockers, shouldFix and advisories explicitly, and that every non-empty advisory list is either folded or booked as not folded - would close the class rather than the instance.
